description: This file is a PHP script for rendering and managing the edit view of a module in the vtiger CRM system, including handling record data, UI blocks, validation, and sequence numbering.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: CRM entity class providing instance retrieval.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template class customized for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of a CRM entity for the current module.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Returns the parent tab/category for the current module.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues.

methods.name: getBasic_Advance_SearchURL
methods.description: Generates URL for basic and advanced search.

methods.name: setObjectValuesFromRequest
methods.description: Sets object properties from HTTP request data.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Determines the view mode based on the focus object.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves UI blocks for the module view.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Fetches the entity name for a given record.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for a record.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for the current module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation data for database fields.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into structured arrays.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence number field for the module.
